changelog.p.002: Diiwaan kooban oo sii-deyn kasta oo dadweyne oo PickVia ah. Nooca ugu dambeeya ka soo dejiso GitHub.
changelog.p.003: Dooro biraawsarro iyo faracyo badan, iyadoo borofayllada Firefox loo ururiyay faraca ay ku xiran yihiin.
changelog.li.001: Ku dar Chrome Dev iyo Canary; Edge Beta, Dev iyo Canary; Brave Beta iyo Nightly; Vivaldi Snapshot; iyo Firefox Developer Edition iyo Nightly sidii doorashooyin biraawsar oo kala gaar ah.
changelog.li.002: Ku dar furitaanka caadiga ah ee heerka abka ee Opera, Arc, Orion iyo Safari Technology Preview.
changelog.li.003: Borofayllada Firefox ku hay faracooda diiwaangashan marka la aqoonsan karo, kana saar nuqulladii hore ee la helay marka dib loo baarayo. Borofayllada aan lahayn xog xiriirin oo lagu kalsoonaan karo waxay haystaan habkii beddelka ahaa ee hore.
changelog.li.004: Hagaaji waddooyinka borofayllada Firefox ee la diiday ka dib markii macOS caadiyeeyay waddooyinka ku-meelgaarka ah.
changelog.li.005: Muuji oo keliya isku-darka furitaanka ee la taageero. Daaqadaha gaarka ahi waxay ahaanayaan doorashooyin heerka biraawsarka ah; hab gaar ah oo borofayl cayiman ah lama heli karo.
changelog.div.002: Qoraallada sii-deynta oo dhan ↗Soo dejiso v1.4 ↓
changelog.p.004: DuckDuckGo hadda waa doorasho biraawsar, oo leh ikhtiyaar gaar ah noocyada rasmiga ah ee la taageero.
changelog.li.006: Ka dooro DuckDuckGo caadi ah ama gaar ah isla daaqadda doorashada.
changelog.li.007: Habka gaarka ahi wuxuu isticmaalaa xog gooni ah oo ku-meelgaar ah, uma baahna kordhin ama oggolaanshaha helitaanka fudud, wuxuuna ku kooban yahay noocyada rasmiga ah ee si toos ah loo soo dejiyo ee la taageero.
changelog.div.004: Qoraallada sii-deynta oo dhan ↗Soo dejiso v1.3 ↓
changelog.p.005: Google Chrome Beta hadda waa doorasho biraawsar oo kala gaar ah, leh borofayllo u gaar ah iyo ikhtiyaarro caadi ah ama gaar ah.
changelog.div.006: Qoraallada sii-deynta oo dhan ↗Soo dejiso v1.2 ↓
changelog.p.006: Xiriiriyeyaasha iimaylka hadda waxay ku furmi karaan abka iimaylka rakiban ee aad doorato.
changelog.li.008: Ka dooro ababka iimaylka diiwaangashan oo maamul kala horreyntooda gudaha Dejimaha Iimaylka.
changelog.li.009: PickVia ma soo bandhigo hordhac mana kaydiyo qaateyaasha, cinwaannada, nuxurka farriimaha ama xiriiriyaha iimaylka asalka ah.
changelog.div.008: Qoraallada sii-deynta oo dhan ↗Soo dejiso v1.1 ↓
changelog.p.007: Sii-deyntii dadweynaha ee ugu horreysay: dooro biraawsar, borofayl ama hab gaar ah oo la taageero xiriiriye kasta oo web ah.
changelog.li.010: Taageer Safari, Chrome, Chromium, Edge, Brave, Vivaldi iyo Firefox.
changelog.li.011: Ku rakib DMG adigoo abka u jiidaya Applications.

changelog.description.001: Qoraallada sii-deynta PickVia, dooraha xiriiriyeyaasha ee si gaar ah loogu sameeyay macOS.
index.title.001: PickVia - Dooro biraawsarka ama borofaylka saxda ah xiriiriye kasta oo web ah
index.p.001: Abka iyo mareegtu waxay ku jiraan 80 luqadood, waxaana jira 12 turjumaad oo README ah. Luqaddaada ka dooro Dejinta.
index.p.002: Doore xiriiriyeyaal oo si gaar ah loogu sameeyay macOS
index.h1.001:
Jooji inaad
xiriiriyeyaasha ku furto
biraawsar ama borofayl qaldan.
index.p.003: PickVia wuxuu ku weydiiyaa ka hor inta uusan furin xiriiriye web ama iimayl, si xiriiriyeyaasha webku ugu tagaan biraawsarka ama borofaylka aad doorato, kuwa iimaylkuna abka aad damacsanayd.
index.div.001: Soo dejiso v1.5.1 ↓★ Xiddig ku sii GitHub
index.p.005: Sawirrada shaashaddu waxay muujiyaan muuqaalka Ingiriisiga.
index.p.007: Dooro meesha ku habboon xiriiriye kasta oo web ama iimayl ah.
index.h3.001: Xiriiriyaha saxda ah, borofaylka saxda ah.
index.p.008: Dooro biraawsar ama borofayl shidan, ama daaqad gaar ah oo heerka biraawsarka ah oo la taageero.
index.p.009: Dooro abka iimaylka diiwaangashan ee aad rabto halkii aad xiriiriye kasta oo mailto: ah ugu diri lahayd isla abka caadiga ah.
index.p.010: Kala hormari doorashooyinkaaga caadiga ah, dabadeed isticmaal hal gujin ama furaha gaaban ee kiiboodhka.
index.p.011: Dooro faracyada kala gaar ah ee Chrome iyo Edge, Brave Beta ama Nightly, Vivaldi Snapshot iyo Firefox Developer Edition ama Nightly. Borofayllada Firefox ee leh xiriir farac oo la yaqaan waxay la joogaan faracaas.
index.p.012: Opera, Arc, Orion iyo Safari Technology Preview waxay bixiyaan doorashooyin biraawsar oo caadi ah. Taageerada borofayllada iyo daaqadaha gaarka ahi way ku kala duwan tahay biraawsarka. Eeg taageerada biraawsarka →
index.p.014: macOS caadi ahaan wuxuu xiriiriyeyaasha mailto: u diraa hal ab oo caadi ah. PickVia wuxuu kuu oggolaanayaa inaad mar kasta ka doorato ababka iimaylka ee Mac-gaaga ka diiwaangashan.
index.div.002: ASTURNAAN LAGU DHISAYPickVia wuxuu codsiga asalka ah si toos ah ugu gudbiyaa doorashadaada. Ma diiwaangeliyo mana kaydiyo nuxurka iimaylka.
index.h2.003:
Hal mar qaabee.
Si dhakhso ah u dooro.
index.p.016: Hal mar qaabee borofayllada biraawsarka iyo ababka iimaylka ee aad caadaysatay, dabadeed kala hormari meelaha aad inta badan ku furto.
index.h2.004:
Ku fur xiriiriyaha xiga
meesha saxda ah.

index.description.001: PickVia wuxuu kuu oggolaanayaa inaad macOS ku doorato biraawsarka ama borofaylka xiriiriye kasta oo web ah iyo abka iimaylka xiriiriye kasta oo iimayl ah.
index.alt.001: Daaqadda doorashada biraawsarka PickVia oo muujinaysa borofayllo biraawsar, meelo gaar ah oo lagu furo iyo furayaasha gaaban ee kiiboodhka
index.alt.002: Daaqadda doorashada iimaylka PickVia oo bixisa ababka iimaylka rakiban
index.alt.003: Dejimaha biraawsarka PickVia oo leh biraawsarro iyo tusaalooyin borofayl
privacy.p.003: PickVia ma ururiyo, ma gudbiyo, ma iibiyo mana wadaago xog shakhsiyeed. Abku ma laha akoonno, falanqayn, xayeysiis ama dirista xogta adeegsiga.
privacy.li.001: Xiriiriyeyaasha waxaa lagu maamulaa qalabkaaga waxaana si toos ah loogu gudbiyaa biraawsarka ama abka iimaylka ee aad doorato.
privacy.li.002: PickVia ma diiwaangeliyo mana hayo URL-yada la furay, qaateyaasha, cinwaannada ama nuxurka farriimaha.
privacy.li.003: Dejimaha waxaa lagu kaydiyaa qalabkaaga gudaha galka Application Support.
privacy.li.004: Markaad siiso gelitaanka borofaylka biraawsarka, PickVia wuxuu qalabkaaga ku kaydiyaa calaamad tixraac oo xadka gelitaankeeda amni ahaan la xaddiday, wuxuuna akhriyaa oo keliya xogta qeexaysa ee loo baahan yahay si loo aqoonsado borofayllada. Ma akhriyo taariikhda daalacashada, kukiyada, fadhiyada, furayaasha sirta ah ee la kaydiyay ama nuxurka bogga.
privacy.p.004: Mareegta PickVia ma isticmaasho falanqayn, raadraacayaal xayeysiis, foomam ama kukiyo uu PickVia dejiyo. Waxaa martigeliya GitHub Pages. GitHub wuxuu maamuli karaa xogta farsamo ee codsiyada sida ku cad Bayaankiisa Asturnaanta.
privacy.p.005: Biraawsarrada, ababka iimaylka, GitHub iyo adeegyada kale ee aad doorato inaad furto ama booqato waxay leeyihiin dhaqammo asturnaan oo u gaar ah. PickVia ma xakameeyo adeegyadaas.
privacy.p.006: Haddii siyaasaddani is beddesho, nooca la cusboonaysiiyay iyo taariikhda uu dhaqan gelayo ayaa lagu daabici doonaa boggan.
privacy.p.007: Su’aalaha ku saabsan asturnaanta waxaa loo diri karaa bozhenpeng93@gmail.com.
terms.p.003: PickVia waa ab macOS ah oo bilaash ah, il-furanna ah. Waad isticmaali kartaa, nuqul ka samayn kartaa, wax ka beddeli kartaa oo qaybin kartaa adigoo raacaya Shatiga MIT ee mashruuca la socda.
terms.p.004: PickVia uma baahna akoon, rukumo ama lacag-bixin. Soo dejinta waxaa laga bixiyaa sii-deynta rasmiga ah ee mashruuca ee GitHub.
terms.p.005: Adiga ayaa masuul ka ah go’aanka rakibidda iyo adeegsiga PickVia, doorashada ababka helaya xiriiriyeyaashaada, sugidda amniga Mac-gaaga iyo raacidda sharciyada khuseeya. Keliya ka gudub ilaalinta macOS Gatekeeper markaad ku kalsoon tahay sii-deynta aad soo dejisay.
terms.p.006: PickVia waxaa lagu bixiyaa “sida uu yahay,” iyada oo aan wax dammaanad ah la bixin. Inta sharcigu oggol yahay, horumariyuhu masuul kama aha waxyeello ama khasaare ka dhasha adeegsiga PickVia ama awood la’aanta adeegsigiisa.
terms.p.007: PickVia wuxuu furi karaa biraawsarro, abab iimayl, mareegaha iyo adeegyada dhinacyada saddexaad. Alaabooyinkaas waxaa xukuma shuruudahooda u gaarka ah, mana xakameeyo mana ansixiyo PickVia.
terms.p.008: PickVia waa la cusboonaysiin karaa, la beddeli karaa ama la joojin karaa wakhti kasta. Shuruudahan sidoo kale waa la cusboonaysiin karaa, iyadoo nooca cusub iyo taariikhda uu dhaqan gelayo lagu daabacayo halkan.
terms.p.009: Su’aalaha ku saabsan shuruudahan waxaa loo diri karaa bozhenpeng93@gmail.com.
